parameters.content:
## CP5 — Reminders engine (separate workflow, bot-automated)
Schedule (hourly) → Load Config (minimal) → Kill-Switch Gate → Compute Reminder Window → Find Due → Build Payload → **Send Disabled?** → dry-run log / **Zernio Template send** → Stamp Reminded. Find Due / Stamp / Zernio-send errors → Reminder Error (visible; owner-alert = Phase 5).

**CP4c send (transport live):** the NoOp STUB is now a real Zernio TEMPLATE send (`POST /v1/inbox/conversations`, business-initiated → template required), GATED by `Send Disabled?` on `bot.whatsappSendDisabled`. Default true = the dry-run branch surfaces the exact payload and NO real send fires. Live send = CP4d (Zernio sandbox + cost approval), flipped by one config flag. Zernio-send error → Reminder Error (a failed send does NOT reach Stamp → reminded stays false → retried = at-least-once).
**Dedupe (two fields):** `reminded` (checkbox) = CONTROL — Find Due selects NOT({reminded}); Stamp sets reminded=true (send-first, stamp-after-success = at-least-once); reschedule sets reminded=false so a moved appointment re-reminds. `reminder_sent` (dateTime) = INFO only (native n8n can't clear a dateTime — null omitted, '' rejected).
**Limits (T1):** Airtable mirror is the source; a GCal-direct cancel could still be reminded; mirror_failed rows get no reminder; two overlapping schedule runs could double-send (accepted TOCTOU, hourly cadence).
